verdict.rationale: A dedicated first-party page covers how Claude model IDs are structured and versioned. It distinguishes pinned versioned IDs from moving, dateless forms and gives per-platform ID tables, which delivers pinning alongside aliases with a documented policy. A standing deprecations page with per-model retirement floors supports the lifecycle side. Missing for 10: explicit quoted detail on when and how aliases advance to new versions, and independent or hands-on corroboration that pinned IDs stay stable.
